title: cart2del_damp_3d
description: `cart2del_damp_3d` calculates delay time, damping, and direction for a direct sound path and early reflections in a three-dimensional mirror-source room model. Configure it with room dimensions, source and listener coordinates, sonic speed, and a minimum radius using messages such as `room_dim`, `src_xyz`, `head_xyz`, `sonic_speed`, and `r_ambi`.
